transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been worrying about… honestly, almost everything lately. My clients, the market, my family, money. Even whether moving to the condo was the right decision. It just feels bigger than it should, compared to what’s actually going on.
Do you find that this worrying happens most days and across many areas of your life, even when there isn’t a clear reason for it?

Yes, most days. It’s not just one thing—I’ll worry about clients, the market, my family, money, and then even things like whether moving to the condo was the right decision. A lot of the time it feels bigger than what’s actually happening.
